preloadBuildDecisions.decision: Produce one CommonJS-compatible bundle per entry, with dynamic first-party imports resolved within that entry build and no unqualified runtime chunk require. preloadBuildDecisions.decision: Treat preload outputs as named resources resolved from the independent packaged application. Recreate all three path consumers and individual load/error attribution. Keep SDK session injection distinct from application webPreferences injection.

preloadBuildDecisions.decision: Keep the 22-property app bridge separate from browser page main-world execution and MCP port initialization. Restore startup handler ordering, worker/theme subscriptions, snapshot semantics and transferred-port lifecycles without exposing ipcRenderer or _linkedBinding as a general escape.
preloadBuildDecisions.qualification: source-derived interface responsibilities; external effects still unverified

preloadBuildDecisions.decision: Qualify package imports against saved emitted contracts, then lock the newly selected versions/integrities independently of the baseline version evidence. React/ReactDOM self-report, Sentry names and mixed browser bundle ranges do not permit whole-file first-party code generation.

Preserve explicit guest preferences and determine app-window sandbox defaults; require real executeInMainWorld/port delivery/ABI behavior before integration acceptance. Reuse named native gaps rather than restarting provider tracing from these entries.
